svg.title: Conservation Officer / British Columbia / Ministry of Environment — integrated compact crest shield (1984 source edition)
svg.desc: Clean vector reconstruction from visible artifact references; no photograph tracing, source textures or embedded raster. Natural outlined replacement fonts approximate embroidered alphabets. Exact stitch anatomy, manufacturing dimensions and calibrated thread colors remain unverified. Whole-master source placement uses uniform scale; the photograph is not used to distort separate border or emblem components.
